scope: Dva/Trii/Chetiri intended succession from serial/full-artifact V550+ stages to producer-owned DAG
core_findings: Dva durable capital is producer-owned direct-reference DAG law; its unsafe premise was assumed upstream V550–V552J sufficiency.
Trii D12–D14 established an exact information/reconstructibility frontier; D15 selected persistent C11 as a strategy rather than proving persistence uniquely necessary.
Chetiri reopened carrier/persistence economics while preserving semantic, negative-state, replay and authority obligations.

No A/B/C architecture winner or benchmark result asserted.
